evidence.note: Installs real boto3 and runs smoke then full boto3 test against core operations plus presigned URL inspection — genuine client verification of signing, not assumption.

Dedicated signing edge-case suite that prints boto3's canonical request and byte-compares against the server's for spaced keys, iterating on canonical-URI/encoding fixes — targeting hard-to-fake SigV4 contract details.

Separate verification scripts for tenants/policy/admin/audit, console API, notifications webhook, lifecycle (fast expiry), concurrency (t6), and edge cases (t7) — covering error codes and multi-subsystem behavior.
Installs Playwright/chromium and drives the console through a browser test against DOM/testids, mirroring the browser UX grader rather than only checking API responses.
Runs full regression suites after fixes plus a cold-boot-from-wiped-data-dir verification, using verification to gate milestones and surface regressions.

reasoning: The agent constructed and ran a broad, repeatable verification harness covering header+query signing (with byte-exact canonical-request diffing vs boto3), error/edge behaviors, multipart/versioning via full boto3 tests, a concurrency load test, admin/audit/notifications/lifecycle, and console side-effects driven through Playwright DOM/testids — re-running regressions after fixes and validating a cold boot. This clearly meets the level-8 anchor and reaches into 10 territory via negative-path, concurrency, and hard-to-fake signing checks that mirror both graders; it stops short of a perfect 10 only because the checks are separate ad-hoc scripts rather than one continuously-run unified suite.
